values.text_68: עבודה משותפת עם ההורים ויישום הנלמד בבית הם המפתח להכללת המיומנויות. לכן, בסוף כל מפגש אני מקדישה זמן לעדכון ולהדרכה ממוקדת.
values.text_71: אשמח להכיר. בשיחה קצרה נבין יחד מה מעסיק אתכם, ונקבע פגישת הערכה ראשונה.
values.text_79: שדות המסומנים ב-* הם שדות חובה.
values.text_102: אין צורך לפרט כאן מידע רפואי – נדבר על כך בשיחה.
values.text_103: אני מסכים/ה שאליה וינשטיין תיצור עמי קשר בנוגע לפנייה זו. *
values.text_104: הפרטים ישמשו אך ורק לצורך חזרה אליכם בנוגע לפנייה, ולא יועברו לגורם אחר מלבד שירות הטכנולוגיה המשמש למשלוח הטופס. מסירת הפרטים נעשית מרצונכם, ואפשר לבקש בכל עת לעיין בהם או למחוק אותם.
values.text_108: קליניקה פרטית בראשון לציון להערכה וטיפול בשפה ובתקשורת אצל ילדים ונוער, בדגש על תקשורת חברתית – בטיפול פרטני, בקבוצות ובהדרכת הורים וצוותים.
values.text_120: © 2026 אליה וינשטיין – קלינאית תקשורת. כל הזכויות שמורות.
values.text_121: המידע באתר הוא כללי ואינו מהווה תחליף להערכה מקצועית אישית.

@font-face{font-family:'Rubik';font-style:normal;font-weight:700;font-display:swap;src:url(data:font/woff;base64,) format('woff')}

:root{
  --ink:#16302f; --teal-900:#1b3a3f; --teal-800:#2c4d54; --teal-700:#3a666f; --teal-600:#4a828d;
  --teal-300:#9fc2c8; --teal-100:#e0ecee; --teal-50:#f1f7f7;
  --accent:#d9825b; --accent-ink:#a2512d; --accent-soft:#f8e7dc; --accent-50:#fdf5ef;
  --sand:#f6f1ea; --bg:#fcfbf8; --surface:#ffffff;
  --text:#2f4447; --muted:#5b6f72; --line:#e4ebea;
  --radius:22px; --radius-sm:14px;
  --shadow-sm:0 1px 2px rgba(22,48,47,.05),0 2px 8px rgba(22,48,47,.05);
  --shadow:0 10px 30px -12px rgba(22,48,47,.18),0 2px 6px rgba(22,48,47,.05);
  --shadow-lg:0 30px 60px -25px rgba(22,48,47,.30);
  --maxw:1180px;
  --font:'Rubik','Assistant','Heebo',system-ui,-apple-system,'Segoe UI',Arial,sans-serif;
}
*,*::before,*::after{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
body{margin:0;overflow-x:clip;font-family:var(--font);font-size:18px;line-height:1.75;color:var(--text);background:var(--bg);-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;text-rendering:optimizeLegibility}
img,svg{display:block;max-width:100%}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}
p{margin:0 0 1em}
h1,h2,h3,h4{color:var(--ink);line-height:1.25;margin:0;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:0}
h1{font-size:clamp(2.1rem,4.6vw,3.6rem)}
h2{font-size:clamp(1.75rem,3.2vw,2.6rem)}
h3{font-size:1.3rem;font-weight:700}
strong{color:var(--ink);font-weight:700}
.ic{width:1.25em;height:1.25em;flex:none}
:focus-visible{outline:3px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:3px;border-radius:8px}
.skip{position:absolute;inset-inline-start:1rem;inset-block-start:-100px;background:var(--teal-800);color:#fff;padding:.6rem 1rem;border-radius:10px;z-index:100}
.skip:focus{inset-block-start:1rem}
.container{width:100%;max-width:var(--maxw);margin-inline:auto;padding-inline:24px}
.narrow{max-width:860px}
section{position:relative}
.section{padding-block:96px}
.section-tight{padding-block:64px}
.bg-sand{background:var(--sand)}
.bg-teal{background:var(--teal-50)}
.eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:.95rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--accent-ink);letter-spacing:.02em;margin-block-end:14px}
.eyebrow::before{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px}
.lead{font-size:1.22rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.8}
.sec-head{max-width:760px;margin-block-end:52px}
.sec-head.center{margin-inline:auto;text-align:center}
.sec-head.center .eyebrow::after{content:"";width:28px;height:2px;background:var(--accent);border-radius:2px}
.sec-head h2{margin-block-end:16px}
.sec-head p{font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--muted);margin:0}

/* buttons */
.btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:.6rem;font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:1.05rem;padding:.9rem 1.6rem;border-radius:999px;border:2px solid transparent;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,background-color .2s ease,color .2s ease;line-height:1.2}
.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
.btn-primary{background:var(--teal-800);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgba(44,77,84,.7)}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--teal-900)}
.btn-accent{background:var(--accent);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 10px 24px -10px rgba(217,130,91,.8)}
.btn-accent:hover{background:#c8714b}
.btn-ghost{background:transparent;color:var(--teal-800);border-color:var(--teal-300)}
.btn-ghost:hover{background:var(--surface);border-color:var(--teal-600)}
.btn-white{background:#fff;color:var(--teal-900)}
.btn-wa{background:#128c3e;color:#fff}
.btn-wa:hover{background:#0f7a36}
.btn-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:14px}
.link-arrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-700)}
.link-arrow .ic{transition:transform .25s ease}
a:hover .link-arrow .ic,.link-arrow:hover .ic{transform:translateX(-5px)}

/* header */
.site-header{position:sticky;inset-block-start:0;z-index:50;background:rgba(252,251,248,.86);backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(14px);-webkit-backdrop-filter:saturate(160%) blur(14px);border-block-end:1px solid transparent;transition:border-color .3s,box-shadow .3s}
.site-header.scrolled{border-block-end-color:var(--line);box-shadow:0 6px 24px -18px rgba(22,48,47,.35)}
.nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;height:80px}
.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px}
.logo-mark{width:44px;height:44px}
.brand-text{display:flex;flex-direction:column;line-height:1.15}
.brand-name{font-weight:800;font-size:1.25rem;color:var(--ink)}
.brand-sub{font-size:.88rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.menu{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.menu a{display:block;padding:.5rem .85rem;border-radius:999px;font-weight:600;color:var(--text);font-size:1.02rem;transition:background-color .2s,color .2s}
.menu a:hover{background:var(--teal-50);color:var(--teal-800)}
.menu a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--teal-800);background:var(--teal-100)}
.nav-end{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px}
.icon-btn{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;color:var(--teal-700);transition:background-color .2s,color .2s}
.icon-btn:hover{background:var(--teal-50);color:var(--teal-900)}
.icon-btn .ic{width:21px;height:21px}
.nav-cta{margin-inline-start:8px;padding:.7rem 1.25rem;font-size:1rem}
.burger{display:none;background:none;border:0;color:var(--teal-900);width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.burger .ic{width:28px;height:28px}
.burger:hover{background:var(--teal-50)}
.mobile-panel{display:none;border-block-start:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--bg);padding:12px 24px 24px}
.mobile-panel.open{display:block}
.mobile-panel ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0}
.mobile-panel li a{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;padding:14px 4px;border-block-end:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:700;font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--ink)}
.mobile-panel li a[aria-current="page"]{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.mobile-social{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-block:16px}
.mobile-panel .btn{width:100%}
@media (max-width:1180px){.menu,.nav-end .icon-btn,.nav-cta{display:none}.burger{display:inline-flex}}

/* hero (home) */
.hero{overflow:hidden;padding-block:72px 96px;background:radial-gradient(1200px 500px at 85% -10%,var(--teal-50),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(800px 400px at 0% 100%,var(--accent-50),transparent 60%)}
.hero-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.hero h1{margin-block:6px 22px;position:relative;z-index:0}
.hero h1 .hl{color:var(--teal-700);position:relative;white-space:nowrap}
.hero h1 .hl::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset-inline:0;inset-block-end:.06em;height:.22em;background:var(--accent-soft);z-index:-1;border-radius:6px}
.hero .lead{max-width:600px;margin-block-end:32px}
.trust{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 26px;margin-block-start:36px;padding:0;list-style:none}
.trust li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-weight:600;color:var(--teal-800);font-size:1rem}
.trust .ic{color:var(--accent);width:22px;height:22px}
.hero-art{position:relative}
.hero-art svg{width:100%;height:auto}
.float-card{position:absolute;background:var(--surface);border-radius:18px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:14px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);font-size:.98rem}
.float-card .ic{width:36px;height:36px;padding:8px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--teal-50);color:var(--teal-700)}
.float-card small{display:block;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:.85rem}
.fc-1{inset-block-start:8%;inset-inline-end:-4%}
.fc-2{inset-block-end:10%;inset-inline-start:-6%}
.fc-2 .ic{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}

/* page hero (inner) */
.page-hero{padding-block:44px 80px;overflow:hidden;background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 90% 0%,var(--teal-50),transparent 65%),radial-gradient(700px 360px at 0% 100%,var(--accent-50),transparent 65%)}
.crumbs{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:.5rem;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted);margin-block-end:36px;list-style:none;padding:0}
.crumbs a{color:var(--teal-700);font-weight:600}
.crumbs a:hover{text-decoration:underline}
.crumbs li+li::before{content:"/";margin-inline-end:.5rem;color:var(--teal-300)}
.ph-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.15fr .85fr;gap:56px;align-items:center}
.page-hero h1{margin-block:4px 20px}
.page-hero .lead{margin-block-end:30px;max-width:620px}

/* cards */
.grid{display:grid;gap:24px}
.g-2{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
.g-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}
.g-4{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr)}
.card{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:32px;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);transition:transform .3s ease,box-shadow .3s ease,border-color .3s}
.card h3{margin-block:18px 10px}
.card p{color:var(--muted);margin:0;font-size:1.05rem}
.card.hover:hover{transform:translateY(-6px);box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg);border-color:transparent}
.badge-ic{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:56px;height:56px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--teal-50);color:var(--teal-700)}
.badge-ic .ic{width:28px;height:28px}
.badge-ic.warm{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}

/* service cards */
.service{display:flex;flex-direction:column;position:relative;overflow:hidden;padding:0}
.service .art{height:190px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--teal-50);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.service .art svg{height:150px;width:auto;transition:transform .5s ease}
.service:hover .art svg{transform:scale(1.06) rotate(-1.5deg)}
.service.warm .art{background:var(--accent-50)}
.service .body{padding:28px 30px 30px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.service h3{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.4rem}
.service p{flex:1;margin-block-end:22px}
.tag{position:absolute;inset-block-start:16px;inset-inline-start:16px;background:var(--accent-ink);color:#fff;font-weight:700;font-size:.82rem;padding:.3rem .8rem;border-radius:999px;z-index:2}
.service-featured{grid-row:span 1}

/* checklist */
.checks{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:14px}
.checks li{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:1.08rem}
.checks li .ic{flex:none;width:28px;height:28px;padding:5px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-100);color:var(--teal-800);margin-block-start:2px}
.checks.warm li .ic{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}

/* signs panel */
.signs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:24px}
.signs .card h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:0 0 18px}
.signs .card h3 .badge-ic{width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:14px}
.note{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:flex-start;margin-block-start:28px;padding:18px 22px;border-radius:var(--radius-sm);background:var(--surface);border:1px dashed var(--teal-300);color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem}
.note .ic{color:var(--teal-600);margin-block-start:4px}

/* steps */
.steps{list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:24px;counter-reset:s;position:relative}
.steps li{position:relative;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:30px 26px;border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.steps .num{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-800);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:1.2rem;margin-block-end:16px;box-shadow:0 0 0 6px var(--teal-50)}
.steps li:nth-child(even) .num{background:var(--accent-ink)}
.steps h3{font-size:1.2rem;margin-block-end:8px}
.steps p{color:var(--muted);font-size:1.02rem;margin:0}

/* split / about teaser */
.split{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:64px;align-items:center}
.portrait{position:relative;aspect-ratio:4/5;border-radius:200px 200px var(--radius) var(--radius);background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--teal-100),var(--teal-50) 55%,var(--accent-50));overflow:hidden;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.portrait .ph{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:14px;color:var(--teal-700);text-align:center;padding:24px}
.portrait .mono{width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--surface);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:2.6rem;font-weight:800;color:var(--teal-800);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.portrait .ph span{font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem;opacity:.85}
.portrait-wrap{position:relative;isolation:isolate;max-width:440px;margin-inline:auto;width:100%}
.portrait-wrap::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto -22px -22px auto;width:70%;height:70%;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--accent-soft);z-index:-1}
.portrait-wrap .float-card{inset-block-end:28px;inset-inline-end:-30px}
blockquote.quote{margin:28px 0;padding:26px 30px;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius);border-inline-start:5px solid var(--accent);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);font-size:1.18rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:500;position:relative}
blockquote.quote::before{content:"”";position:absolute;inset-block-start:-18px;inset-inline-end:22px;font-size:5rem;line-height:1;color:var(--accent-soft);font-family:Georgia,serif}
blockquote.quote footer{margin-block-start:12px;font-size:1rem;color:var(--accent-ink);font-weight:700}

/* principles */
.principle{display:flex;gap:18px;align-items:flex-start;padding:26px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line)}
.principle h3{font-size:1.18rem;margin-block-end:6px}
.principle p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.02rem}

/* prose */
.prose p{font-size:1.12rem}
.prose h2{margin-block:8px 18px}
.prose h3{margin-block:34px 12px;font-size:1.45rem}

/* info list */
.facts{display:grid;gap:0;background:var(--surface);border-radius:var(--radius);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow);overflow:hidden}
.facts .row{display:flex;gap:16px;align-items:center;padding:20px 24px;border-block-end:1px solid var(--line)}
.facts .row:last-child{border-block-end:0}
.facts .row .badge-ic{width:48px;height:48px;border-radius:14px}
.facts .k{font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.facts .v{font-size:1.1rem;color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;line-height:1.35}
.facts-head{padding:20px 24px;background:var(--teal-800);color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:1.15rem}

/* audience blocks */
.aud{display:grid;grid-template-columns:280px 1fr;gap:40px;padding:40px;border-radius:var(--radius);background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.aud+.aud{margin-block-start:24px}
.aud-head h3{font-size:1.55rem;margin-block:16px 10px}
.aud-head p{color:var(--muted);margin:0;font-size:1.05rem}

/* chips */
.chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0}
.chips li{padding:.45rem 1rem;border-radius:999px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);font-weight:600;color:var(--teal-800);font-size:.98rem}

/* placeholder to fill */
.todo{background:#fff6d6;border:1px dashed #d9b44a;border-radius:6px;padding:0 .35em;color:#7a5b00;font-weight:600}

/* FAQ */
.faq{display:grid;gap:14px}
.faq details{background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:18px;padding:0 26px;transition:box-shadow .3s,border-color .3s}
.faq details[open]{box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:transparent}
.faq summary{list-style:none;cursor:pointer;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:22px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:1.15rem;color:var(--ink)}
.faq summary::-webkit-details-marker{display:none}
.faq summary .ic{color:var(--teal-600);transition:transform .3s;width:24px;height:24px}
.faq details[open] summary .ic{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.faq .ans{padding-block-end:22px;color:var(--muted);font-size:1.07rem}
.faq .ans p:last-child{margin:0}

/* contact */
.contact{padding-block:96px}
.contact-box{position:relative;overflow:hidden;border-radius:32px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal-900),var(--teal-800) 60%,#356068);color:#fff;padding:64px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:48px;align-items:center;box-shadow:var(--shadow-lg)}
.contact-box::before,.contact-box::after{content:"";position:absolute;border-radius:50%;pointer-events:none}
.contact-box::before{width:420px;height:420px;inset-block-start:-180px;inset-inline-start:-140px;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(233,162,127,.28),transparent 70%)}
.contact-box::after{width:360px;height:360px;inset-block-end:-200px;inset-inline-end:20%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(159,194,200,.22),transparent 70%)}
.contact-box > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
.contact-box h2{color:#fff;margin-block-end:16px}
.contact-box .eyebrow{color:#f3c3a8}
.contact-box .eyebrow::before{background:#f3c3a8}
.contact-box p{color:#d6e6e8;font-size:1.15rem}
.c-list{display:grid;gap:14px}
.c-item{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:18px 20px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);transition:background-color .2s,transform .2s}
a.c-item:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);transform:translateY(-2px)}
.c-item .ci{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.12);color:#fff;flex:none}
.c-item .ci .ic{width:24px;height:24px}
.c-item .k{font-size:.9rem;color:#b9d3d6}
.c-item .v{font-size:1.25rem;font-weight:800;color:#fff;line-height:1.3}
.c-item.wa .ci{background:#1fae54}

/* footer */
.site-footer{background:var(--ink);color:#b9cccd;padding-block:64px 28px;font-size:1rem}
.f-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.4fr 1fr 1fr;gap:40px}
.site-footer .brand-name{color:#fff}
.site-footer .logo-mark path{fill:#4a828d}
.site-footer .brand-sub{color:#9db7b9}
.site-footer h4{color:#fff;font-size:1.05rem;margin-block-end:14px}
.site-footer ul{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:8px}
.site-footer a:hover{color:#fff}
.f-a11y{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.4rem;color:#cfe0e1;text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:3px}
.f-about{margin-block-start:16px;max-width:380px;line-height:1.7}
.f-social{display:flex;gap:6px;margin-block-start:16px}
.f-social .icon-btn{color:#cfe0e1;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.f-social .icon-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.14);color:#fff}
.f-bottom{margin-block-start:44px;padding-block-start:22px;border-block-start:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;font-size:.92rem;color:#8eaaac}

/* whatsapp widget */
.wa-widget{position:fixed;inset-block-end:24px;inset-inline-end:24px;z-index:60;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:8px}
.wa-close{width:26px;height:26px;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--line);color:var(--muted);display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);padding:0}
.wa-close .ic{width:14px;height:14px}
.wa-close:hover{color:var(--ink)}
.wa-btn{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;background:#128c3e;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:12px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -10px rgba(31,174,84,.7);transition:transform .2s,background-color .2s}
.wa-btn:hover{transform:scale(1.05);background:#0f7a36}
.wa-btn .ic{width:32px;height:32px}
.wa-btn .wa-label{font-weight:700;padding-inline-end:8px;display:none}
@media (min-width:900px){.wa-btn{padding:12px 14px}.wa-btn .wa-label{display:inline}}
.wa-widget.hidden{display:none}


/* contact form */
.contact-box{grid-template-columns:.9fr 1.1fr;align-items:start}
.c-social{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-block-start:18px}
.c-social .icon-btn{color:#d6e6e8;background:rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.c-social .icon-btn:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.16);color:#fff}
.form-card{background:var(--surface);color:var(--text);border-radius:24px;padding:34px;box-shadow:0 30px 60px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.45)}
.form-card h3{font-size:1.4rem;margin-block-end:4px}
.form-card .sub{color:var(--muted);font-size:1rem;margin-block-end:22px}
.f-row{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px}
.field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:6px;margin-block-end:16px}
.field label{font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);font-size:.98rem}
.field .opt{font-weight:500;color:var(--muted);font-size:.88rem}
.field input,.field select,.field textarea{font-family:inherit;font-size:1.02rem;color:var(--ink);background:var(--bg);border:1.5px solid #cfdcdb;border-radius:12px;padding:.75rem .9rem;transition:border-color .2s,box-shadow .2s,background-color .2s;width:100%}
.field textarea{min-height:110px;resize:vertical;line-height:1.6}
.field select{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;background-image:linear-gradient(45deg,transparent 50%,var(--teal-700) 50%),linear-gradient(135deg,var(--teal-700) 50%,transparent 50%);background-position:left 18px center,left 12px center;background-size:6px 6px,6px 6px;background-repeat:no-repeat;padding-inline-end:.9rem;padding-inline-start:2.2rem}
.field input:focus,.field select:focus,.field textarea:focus{outline:none;border-color:var(--teal-600);background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 4px rgba(74,130,141,.18)}
.field [aria-invalid="true"]{border-color:#b42318;background:#fff8f7}
.err{color:#b42318;font-size:.9rem;font-weight:600;min-height:0}
.err:empty{display:none}
.hp{position:absolute!important;inset-inline-start:-9999px;width:1px;height:1px;overflow:hidden}
.consent{display:flex;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start;font-size:.95rem;color:var(--muted);margin-block:4px 6px;line-height:1.55}
.consent input{width:20px;height:20px;margin-block-start:3px;accent-color:var(--teal-700);flex:none}
.privacy{font-size:.86rem;color:var(--muted);line-height:1.55;margin:10px 0 18px}
.form-card .btn{width:100%;font-size:1.1rem;padding:1rem}
.form-card .btn[disabled]{opacity:.65;cursor:wait;transform:none}
.f-status{margin-block-start:14px;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 14px;font-weight:600;font-size:.98rem}
.f-status:empty{display:none}
.f-status.ok{background:#e8f6ee;color:#11633a;border:1px solid #bfe5cf}
.f-status.bad{background:#fdecea;color:#912018;border:1px solid #f5c2bc}

/* articles */
.art-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column;padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.art-card .cover{height:150px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--teal-50);color:var(--teal-700)}
.art-card.warm .cover{background:var(--accent-50);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.art-card .cover .ic{width:64px;height:64px;stroke-width:1.4}
.art-card .body{padding:26px 28px 28px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;flex:1}
.art-card h3{font-size:1.3rem;margin:8px 0 10px}
.art-card p{flex:1;margin-block-end:18px}
.meta{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px 16px;font-size:.9rem;color:var(--muted);font-weight:600}
.meta span{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:.35rem}
.meta .ic{width:16px;height:16px}
.cat{display:inline-block;font-size:.82rem;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-800);background:var(--teal-100);padding:.2rem .7rem;border-radius:999px}
.warm .cat{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.article-hero{padding-block:44px 56px;background:radial-gradient(900px 420px at 90% 0%,var(--teal-50),transparent 65%),radial-gradient(700px 360px at 0% 100%,var(--accent-50),transparent 65%)}
.article-hero h1{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,4vw,3rem);margin-block:14px 18px}
.article-hero .lead{margin-block-end:22px}
.byline{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:.98rem;color:var(--muted)}
.byline .av{width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-800);color:#fff;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-weight:700}
.byline strong{display:block;color:var(--ink)}
.article{padding-block:56px 24px}
.article .prose{max-width:760px;margin-inline:auto}
.prose h2{font-size:clamp(1.45rem,2.6vw,1.9rem);margin-block:44px 14px}
.prose ul.dots{padding-inline-start:1.3rem;margin:0 0 1.2em}
.prose ul.dots li{margin-block-end:.5em}
.prose ul.dots li::marker{color:var(--accent)}
.callout{display:flex;gap:14px;align-items:flex-start;padding:20px 24px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--teal-50);border:1px solid var(--teal-100);margin:26px 0;font-size:1.05rem}
.callout .ic{color:var(--teal-700);width:26px;height:26px;margin-block-start:3px}
.callout.warm{background:var(--accent-50);border-color:var(--accent-soft)}
.callout.warm .ic{color:var(--accent-ink)}
.callout p:last-child{margin:0}
.callout strong{display:block;margin-block-end:4px}
.tip{position:relative;padding:22px 24px 22px 24px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm);margin-block-end:18px}
.tip h3{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;font-size:1.22rem;margin:0 0 8px}
.tip h3 .n{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--teal-800);color:#fff;font-size:1rem;flex:none}
.tip:nth-of-type(even) h3 .n{background:var(--accent-ink)}
.tip p{margin:0;color:var(--text);font-size:1.06rem}
.tip .ex{margin-block-start:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:12px;background:var(--sand);font-size:1rem;color:var(--ink)}
.timeline{list-style:none;margin:24px 0;padding:0;display:grid;gap:16px}
.timeline li{display:grid;grid-template-columns:120px 1fr;gap:20px;align-items:start;padding:22px 24px;border-radius:18px;background:var(--surface);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:var(--shadow-sm)}
.timeline .age{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;font-weight:700;color:var(--teal-800);background:var(--teal-100);border-radius:14px;padding:12px 8px;line-height:1.3;font-size:1.02rem}
.timeline li:nth-child(even) .age{background:var(--accent-soft);color:var(--accent-ink)}
.timeline ul{margin:0;padding-inline-start:1.1rem}
.timeline ul li{display:list-item;padding:0;border:0;box-shadow:none;background:none;border-radius:0;margin-block-end:.3em}
.timeline ul li::marker{color:var(--accent)}
.flags{background:#fff8f3;border:1px solid var(--accent-soft);border-radius:var(--radius);padding:26px 28px;margin:22px 0}
.flags h3{margin:0 0 12px;font-size:1.2rem;color:var(--accent-ink)}
.bottom-line{background:var(--teal-800);color:#d6e6e8;border-radius:var(--radius);padding:28px 30px;margin:40px 0 0}
.bottom-line h2{color:#fff;margin:0 0 10px;font-size:1.4rem}
.bottom-line p{margin:0;font-size:1.08rem}
.disclaimer{margin-block-start:26px;font-size:.92rem;color:var(--muted);border-block-start:1px solid var(--line);padding-block-start:16px}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .f-row{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:0}
  .form-card{padding:24px 20px}
  .timeline li{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}
  .timeline .age{justify-content:flex-start;padding:8px 14px;width:max-content}
  .g-3 > .service:last-child:nth-child(odd){flex-direction:column}
}

/* reveal */
.js .reveal{opacity:0;transform:translateY(22px);transition:opacity .7s ease,transform .7s ease}
.js .reveal.in{opacity:1;transform:none}
.js .reveal.d1{transition-delay:.08s}.js .reveal.d2{transition-delay:.16s}.js .reveal.d3{transition-delay:.24s}
@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){html{scroll-behavior:auto}.js .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none;transition:none}*{transition:none!important;animation:none!important}}

/* responsive */
@media (max-width:1060px){
  .g-4,.steps{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .hero-grid,.ph-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .hero-art,.ph-art{max-width:520px;margin-inline:auto;width:100%}
  .split{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:56px}
  .contact-box{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:48px 36px}
  .aud{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:24px}
}
@media (min-width:761px) and (max-width:1060px){
  .g-3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
  .g-3 > :last-child:nth-child(odd){grid-column:1 / -1}
  .g-3 > .service:last-child:nth-child(odd){flex-direction:row;align-items:stretch}
  .g-3 > .service:last-child:nth-child(odd) .art{width:42%;height:auto;min-height:220px}
  .signs .card{padding:28px}
}
@media (max-width:760px){
  body{font-size:17px}
  .section,.contact{padding-block:68px}
  .hero{padding-block:40px 64px}
  .g-2,.g-3,.g-4,.steps,.signs{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .f-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:32px}
  .card,.aud{padding:26px}
  .contact-box{padding:40px 22px;border-radius:24px}
  .fc-1{inset-inline-end:0}.fc-2{inset-inline-start:0}
  .portrait-wrap .float-card{inset-inline-end:0}
  .hero h1 .hl{white-space:normal}
  .nav{height:70px}
  .brand-sub{font-size:.8rem}
  .btn-row .btn{flex:1 1 100%}
}
@media print{.site-header,.wa-widget,.contact-box::before,.contact-box::after{display:none}.js .reveal{opacity:1;transform:none}}
</style>
